faults.page says: The imprint names Verein Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky Club (ZVR 854118344) only as Herausgeber of the website; it says nothing about the Zentrum's legal form. The page that states it, https://www.schuette-lihotzky.at/de/zentrum/verein-msl-club/, says the Club was founded in 2013 as Trägerverein und Organisationsform des gesamten Tätigkeitsbereichs, and is not among the cited urls.

faults.stored: The imprint names Verein Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky Club (ZVR 854118344) as publisher of the Zentrum's site.
faults.page says: The imprint proves only who publishes the site; the Verein MSL Club page proves the Verein is the Zentrum's supporting association.
faults.fix: The Verein MSL Club page states the Margarete Schütte-Lihotzky Club (ZVR 854118344) was founded in 2013 as the supporting association and organisational form of the Zentrum's whole field of activity.

faults.page says: The Herita page says only that Herita (vzw) has worked with Stad Antwerpen since 2024 to open the house to the public and is studying restoration needs; it does not say Herita owns or runs Braemhuis or give the house a legal form. The Flemish Government decision of 13 December 2024 concerns Herita's recognition as a heritage network and does not mention Braemhuis. A partner's form is not the space's form.
